An '''interrogator'''<ref name="SWE 142">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', 142.</ref> or '''interrogator module'''<ref name="SWE 137">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', 137 {{C|Under ''ID profile''}}.</ref> was a device that could emit a high-frequency electronic signal to [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. This signal caused the [[transponder]] of the targeted starship to broadcast its encoded [[ID profile]],<ref name="SWE 142" /> containing identifying information about the ship. Interrogators were frequently found in [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] control towers and aboard military starships.<ref name="SWE 137" />
